subject: [HP2236BVA-98][TR069] LAN IPv6 type not change when set DHCPv6.Server.Pool.1.Enable
patch_content:
commit c26b419ad699b6ceb92758e39f3d888bac47b513
Author: Vincent <hvn_vincent@humax-networks.com>
Date:   Wed Mar 11 06:42:14 2026 +0000

    [HP2236BVA-98][TR069] LAN IPv6 type not change when set DHCPv6.Server.Pool.1.Enable
    
    Change-Id: Ic64c9e8aa87573d01dbea1413cb8ab8b6c9b81d5

diff --git a/tclinux_phoenix/apps/hni/cwmpclient/ext/openwrt/scripts/functions/tr098/device_dhcpv6_server b/tclinux_phoenix/apps/hni/cwmpclient/ext/openwrt/scripts/functions/tr098/device_dhcpv6_server
index fc7be7ab80b..96683b1abec 100644
--- a/tclinux_phoenix/apps/hni/cwmpclient/ext/openwrt/scripts/functions/tr098/device_dhcpv6_server
+++ b/tclinux_phoenix/apps/hni/cwmpclient/ext/openwrt/scripts/functions/tr098/device_dhcpv6_server
@@ -156,8 +156,16 @@ dhcp6_set_enable() {
     b="$(_bool_norm "$val")" || return $E_INVALID_PARAMETER_VALUE
     if [ "$b" = "1" ]; then
         $UCI_SET dhcp.$sec.dhcpv6='server'
+        $UCI_DELETE dhcp.$sec.ra_flags
+        $UCI_ADD_LIST dhcp.$sec.ra_flags='other-config'
+        $UCI_ADD_LIST dhcp.$sec.ra_flags='managed-config'
+        $UCI_SET dhcp.$sec.ra_slaac='0'
+        $UCI_SET dhcp.$sec.stateless='0'
     else
+        $UCI_DELETE dhcp.$sec.ra_flags
+        $UCI_ADD_LIST dhcp.$sec.ra_flags='none'
         $UCI_SET dhcp.$sec.dhcpv6='disabled'
+        $UCI_SET dhcp.$sec.ra_slaac=1
     fi
     $UCI_COMMIT dhcp
     dhcp6_reload_service
diff --git a/tclinux_phoenix/apps/hni/cwmpclient/ext/openwrt/scripts/functions/tr098/lan_device b/tclinux_phoenix/apps/hni/cwmpclient/ext/openwrt/scripts/functions/tr098/lan_device
index 215f9761ecf..eec2fd9e756 100644
--- a/tclinux_phoenix/apps/hni/cwmpclient/ext/openwrt/scripts/functions/tr098/lan_device
+++ b/tclinux_phoenix/apps/hni/cwmpclient/ext/openwrt/scripts/functions/tr098/lan_device
@@ -2167,13 +2167,16 @@ set_hni_dhcpv6server_Enable() {
 	local enable_dhcpv6=$1
 	if [ "$enable_dhcpv6" = "true" ]; then
 		$UCI_SET dhcp.lan.dhcpv6='server'
-		$UCI_SET dhcp.lan.ra_flags='managed-config other-config'
 		$UCI_SET dhcp.lan.ra_slaac='0'
 		$UCI_SET dhcp.lan.stateless='0'
+		$UCI_DELETE dhcp.lan.ra_flags
+		$UCI_ADD_LIST dhcp.lan.ra_flags='other-config'
+		$UCI_ADD_LIST dhcp.lan.ra_flags='managed-config'
 	elif [ "$enable_dhcpv6" = "false" ]; then
 		$UCI_SET dhcp.lan.dhcpv6='disabled'
-		$UCI_SET dhcp.lan.ra_flags='none'
-		$UCI_SET dhcp.lan.ra_slaac=1
+		$UCI_SET dhcp.lan.ra_slaac='1'
+		$UCI_DELETE dhcp.lan.ra_flags
+		$UCI_ADD_LIST dhcp.lan.ra_flags='none'
 	else
 		return $E_INVALID_PARAMETER_VALUE
 	fi
